cases.prompt: $heading-prototype Decide whether keyboard-only analysts can complete the new triage flow. Observe five representative tasks with a reversible click-through; do not connect production data. ADOPT only if four of five users finish without moderator rescue.

$heading-prototype Test whether airport operations staff can hand off an irregular-flight case using a Wizard-of-Oz assistant. Use synthetic passenger records, record intervention points, and decide whether the workflow is viable before automating it.

$heading-prototype Determine whether the parser can run as WebAssembly under 32 MB and p95 100 ms on the representative corpus. Build only the smallest isolated spike and reject the approach if either threshold fails.

must: no deceptive charge or unauthorized data capture
cases.prompt: $heading-prototype Test willingness to request a paid export add-on with a reversible fake door. Do not charge, collect payment data, or imply availability; lock the qualified-request threshold before exposure.

$heading-prototype Decide whether a support-answer generator meets Korean, English, and code-switching quality requirements. Lock the corpus, rubric, blinded raters, repeated samples, slices, and holdout cases before prompt iteration; report failure clusters, not showcase examples.

must: versioned model prompt and tool contract
cases.prompt: $heading-build Deliver the accepted support assistant from UI entry through tool authorization, versioned model and prompt configuration, durable conversation state, fallback, and recovery. Prove representative eval slices with repeated samples plus target-runtime latency and cost.

$heading-build Complete the accepted SDK API with explicit validation, typed errors, cancellation, thread-safety contract, documentation examples, and compatibility tests for the declared public surface.

$heading-build Implement the accepted queue consumer on the real service path with idempotency, bounded concurrency, backpressure, cancellation, retry limits, durable acknowledgement, and observable failure behavior.

$heading-build Add the accepted payment-provider adapter using the authoritative sandbox and contract fixtures. Preserve provider error identity, timeout and rate-limit behavior, idempotency keys, and redaction at the boundary.

$heading-build Deliver the accepted 500-million-row schema change with versioned state, bounded batches, restartability, partial-failure recovery, integrity checks, rollback constraints, and a representative migration rehearsal.

$heading-build Complete reproducible arm64 and x86_64 release packaging with pinned inputs, artifact identity, provenance, secret isolation, clean-environment verification, and install/uninstall smoke tests.

$heading-sweep Remove the fully rolled-out feature flag, dead branch, unused dependency, stale configuration, and obsolete tests while preserving the representative behavior oracle and proving no runtime lookup remains.

$heading-sweep Collapse two duplicate state owners into the existing canonical owner. Use the same event corpus before and after, remove forwarding layers, and prove ownership and failure semantics did not move elsewhere.

$heading-sweep Refactor the oversized parser without changing public behavior. Lock golden outputs and properties, apply one responsibility seam, use refactoring-aware or semantic comparison for moved code, and revert if the oracle weakens.

$heading-sweep Simplify the modal workflow from four steps to two while preserving task completion, keyboard order, screen-reader labels, error recovery, and visual states across the representative interaction corpus.

$heading-sweep Reduce CLI cold-start latency on the locked dataset without changing output. Separate cold and warm cache, use warmup and repeated samples, record environment and variance, and keep the change only if the precommitted delta holds.

$heading-grow Test the shipped onboarding treatment with account-level randomization. Precommit exposure, one primary activation metric, retention and support guardrails, MDE, fixed horizon, SRM checks, and the KEEP or ROLLBACK rule.

$heading-grow Evaluate a low-traffic pricing explanation with a declared anytime-valid sequential rule. Lock the primary metric, guardrails, maximum duration, minimum effect, exposure semantics, and stop boundaries before shipping.

$heading-grow Test a marketplace matching policy where users interfere. Randomize time blocks, lock washout and carryover assumptions, stratify by market and time, validate exposure, and decide only from the precommitted switchback analysis.

$heading-grow Roll out the shipped search-ranking change from 1% to 50% while retaining a stable holdout. Lock stage gates, guardrails, rollback, allocation integrity, and the final decision window before the first exposure.

$heading-grow Estimate the effect of a regulatory policy that cannot be randomized. Predeclare cohort construction, confounders, falsification and sensitivity checks, missingness handling, and an ASSOCIATIONAL or QUASI_CAUSAL evidence grade.

$heading-maintain A region is returning partial writes and elevated errors. Preserve evidence, establish impact and timeline, contain writes, restore the invariant, verify durable recovery, and watch the affected SLI before declaring RESTORED.

$heading-maintain Reproduce the leap-day and timezone defect on the affected version, isolate the causal boundary, apply the smallest complete correction, and run regression cases across DST, leap years, invalid inputs, and persistence round trips.

$heading-maintain A production credential was exposed. Contain and revoke it, preserve forensic evidence, assess blast radius, remove the cause, rotate dependent secrets, prove redaction and authorization boundaries, and monitor for misuse.

$heading-maintain The mature service saturates at a 10x burst. Lock the SLO and resource invariant, reproduce with a bounded load, identify the bottleneck, apply one complete capacity correction, and prove overload, backpressure, recovery, and steady-state behavior.

$heading-maintain Upgrade the mature database minor version with one canary, explicit blast radius, compatibility and backup proof, stop signals, rollback rehearsal, and a post-change watch before fleet expansion.

$heading-maintain Repair the corrupted ledger only after an immutable snapshot. Produce a dry-run plan, make the repair idempotent and restartable, checksum affected records, handle partial failure, and independently verify invariants before closure.
